source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Complete all required sections, including:

   - Date and time of the accident
   - Location where the accident occurred
   - Name and job title of the employee(s) involved
   - Name(s) of witness(es), if any, and their contact information
   - A detailed description of the accident - how it happened, what went wrong, etc.
   - Any immediate actions taken on the scene (e.g., first aid, emergency services called)

3. Obtain statements from involved employees and witnesses.
   - Document their recollection of the event to understand the sequence of events.
   - Record verbal statements or have them write down their own version of what happened.

4. Conduct a thorough investigation if necessary.
   - Collect safety data sheets for any chemicals involved.
   - Review any maintenance records or safety inspections relevant to the accident location or equipment.
   - Look into similar past accidents for patterns or recurring issues.
   - Interview management staff about
